'''Leeland Simmons''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Houston Grand Slam]] on 8 July 2000 with M&T with heavy SAC, according to Justin Warren's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d988">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-09-houston-grand-slam-7-8-00d988/ houston-grand-slam-7-8-00], DeckTech (Justin "hoostino" Warren, 9 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-09-houston-grand-slam-7-8-00d988/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
